scope.model_selection: Every raw TOML row in the remaining Anthropic, xAI, OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot profiles.
scope.region: Default catalog endpoints only. No regional, account, subscription or upstream-router entitlement is inferred.
scope.unknown_policy: Unknown records insufficient reviewed evidence, not lack of upstream support. Missing features, similar names, family ancestry, and failed page fetches never establish unsupported.
scope.availability_policy: Feature cells describe documented contracts. Separately consult availability; documented is not an account-level availability guarantee, and shut_down overrides callability.
scope.freshness_policy: Each source, model row and service retains its own evidence date; evidence_date is the latest review date in the matrix. Tests make no network requests.
scope.protocol_policy: Each primary Chat, Responses or Messages wire contract is distinct. Independent service support does not imply that the primary chat endpoint accepts that operation.

openrouter_directory.validation: Public unauthenticated metadata read only; no inference or account validation.

scope.copilot_policy: GitHub product/CLI/SDK documentation does not establish the api.githubcopilot.com raw HTTP capability contract.
scope.cloud_service_policy: Cloud-platform service records describe documented hosting and tool-version boundaries only; they do not create catalog profiles, establish model-level support, or validate deployment/account availability.

basis_definitions.documented_alias: An official page explicitly identifies the alias target; no name-based alias guess is used.
basis_definitions.not_established: Reviewed sources do not establish model-and-operation support; the source points to the reviewed context, not negative proof.

Both Hosted on Azure and Hosted on Anthropic support tool_search_tool_regex_20251119 and tool_search_tool_bm25_20251119. The feature is stable without a beta header; individual models must still satisfy the Tool Search compatibility table.

Hosted on Azure supports only web_fetch_20250910. Later versions, dynamic filtering, use_cache/cache bypass and response_inclusion are excluded; Foundry documents HTTP 400 for these unsupported features. No live rejection was tested.

Hosted on Anthropic supports all currently documented versions: web_fetch_20250910, web_fetch_20260209, web_fetch_20260309 and web_fetch_20260318. Dynamic filtering retains model restrictions; use_cache requires 20260309 or later and response_inclusion requires 20260318 or later.

Documented scope is the Claude API: mcp-client-2026-09-15 includes the 2025 connector, pins mcp_toolset.tools and replays mcp_tool_listing. Foundry support remains unestablished; the API-only positive evidence is not a tested Foundry rejection.
